One fix on top of 1.12.0, found while checking the release it belongs to.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **The rainbow palette shows the instance's own eight colours even while the mode is off.** With the mode off the app fell back to the default palette, which was invisible for as long as nothing drew those colours — and 1.12.0 started drawing them, as the dimmed row on the settings screen. On an instance with a palette of its own that row showed the wrong eight, and switching the mode on replaced them with eight different ones. Whether the mode is on is one thing; which colours it hands out is another.

Settings live under **Overview › the gear › Appearance › Colour palette**.
